title: YouTube selection
question: Does this lesson teach its subject substantially better through its current visuals and motion than through reading the article?

dimensions.title: Visual learning value
dimensions.criteria: A learner follows spatial relationships, changing state, a simulation, or a computation that makes the mechanism easier to understand. Motion carries an explanatory step. Attractive text, cards, icons, and checklists alone do not satisfy this requirement.

anchors.36-40: The changing picture is central to understanding the mechanism.
anchors.30-35: The visual explanation provides a substantial, concrete learning advantage.
anchors.20-29: The lesson mainly presents code, prose, tables, workflows, or procedures that reading explains efficiently.
anchors.0-19: The visuals add little explanatory value to the spoken text.

dimensions.title: Explanation
dimensions.criteria: The current script builds a correct mental model, motivates the question, introduces necessary concepts, and connects the examples to a general explanation.

dimensions.title: Visual execution
dimensions.criteria: The actual encoded scene and motion samples clearly connect the visual states to the explanation. Objects, labels, mathematical notation, transitions, and pacing help the viewer follow the mechanism.

dimensions.title: Standalone viewing
dimensions.criteria: The current lesson answers an understandable question, earns sustained viewing, and provides a useful standalone explanation. Tool-specific details support a mechanism with lasting value.

decisionRule: Keep only when the total and every dimension minimum are met, the existing quality score is at least 90, current media evidence matches, and there are no publication blockers. Otherwise skip this version and explain why reading is preferable or what visual treatment would earn reconsideration.
scope: Editorial format selection based on each complete script and animation model, current encoded scene and motion samples, and the existing quality review. These decisions assess the current videos. They do not predict audience size or claim continuous playback or full audible listening.
